name: Koa
source:
A big guy with a relaxed, chill and loveable vibe. Hailing from Kona, Hawaii (or Kailua-Kona on the Big Island), Koa likes to relax and eat good food with friends. Any time someone is down or feeling out of it, Koa hears them out. He's a great listener and thrives on helping friends. For being such a helpful and giving guy, he doesn't seem to ask much in return. he would never want to burden anyone else with his woes, because for him, that would ruin all the fun.
Likes: Peace, Quiet, Owning and Operating a Fusion Restaurant 
Dislikes: Being a Downer

[From the in-game Date-a-dex]
